```python
def count_liberties(board, r, c, player):
    """Count liberties of group at r,c. Assume board[r,c] == player."""
    visited = set()
    libs = set()
    stack = [(r, c)]
    while stack:
        cr, cc = stack.pop()
        if (cr, cc) in visited:
            continue
        visited.add((cr, cc))
        for dr, dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
            nr, nc = cr + dr, cc + dc
            if 0 <= nr < 19 and 0 <= nc < 19:
                if board[nr, nc] == 0:
                    libs.add((nr, nc))
                elif board[nr, nc] == player and (nr, nc) not in visited:
                    stack.append((nr, nc))
    return len(libs), visited
```
